subject: RE: Redwood - Next steps on procurement, DPA & SOC2
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@acme.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra; dev_patel
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood - Recap + next steps (procurement & security)

Hi Alice —

Great to speak with you and the team earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Recap from discovery:
- ACME is evaluating Redwood for inference across a couple of pilot products (search rerank + customer support embeddings).
- Procurement preference: PO/credit terms preferred for enterprise deals — card payments acceptable for a shorter pilot.
- Marketplace interest: you asked whether Redwood is available on AWS Marketplace (could speed up CC) — short answer: yes, we can support marketplace listing; will confirm timing.
- Security gating: SOC 2, signed DPA, and completion of your security questionnaire are the primary gating items called out by procurement.

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll share a draft DPA and SOC2 summary now. (Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Draft.pdf, SOC2_Summary.xlsx)
2) I’m looping in Dev (security) to confirm what we can provide for your questionnaire and expected turnaround.
3) I’ll loop in Rishi from Commercial on PO vs card terms and any standard order form we should use.
4) Please share your procurement contact or PO template (if different from procurement@acme.com) and an expected timeline to route PO internally.

If that looks right, I’ll follow up with the documents + a proposed mutual action plan for signatures and PO issuance.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Draft.pdf (draft), SOC2_Summary.xlsx (summary)

From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood - Recap + next steps (procurement & security)

Thanks Marissa —

Appreciate the recap. A few notes from procurement: 
- Procurement prefers to execute via PO and net-30 terms for pilots > $25k. For smaller pilots we usually pay by card to move faster.
- Please send a DPA and any SOC 2 artefacts (report or summary) we can share with our security team. We’ll also need you to complete our vendor security questionnaire (attached).
- We are interested in the marketplace option if that keeps things moving while procurement processes the PO. If you can confirm whether Redwood is in AWS Marketplace and whether you can accept card payment there, that would help us pick the path.

Procurement timeline: our internal approvals typically take 2–3 weeks once we have a DPA + SOC2 evidence. We’ll start the procurement intake this week but need the documents to proceed.

Attaching: ACME_vendor_security_questionnaire.pdf, ACME_PO_Template.xlsx

Thanks,
Alice Nguyen
Senior Product Manager, ACME Corp
alice.nguyen@acme.com

- Rishi: confirm whether we can accept PO with net-30 for a pilot at the quoted levels, and whether we should propose a marketplace/CC fallback to speed pilot start.

Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@acme.com>, rishi_malhotra
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Redwood - Recap + next steps (procurement & security)

Hi all —

Quick security answers: 
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (security & availability) in March 2026. We can provide the SOC 2 report under NDA and a redacted SOC 2 summary (attached) to share with your team immediately.
- DPA: Marissa included the DPA draft. We typically execute via DocuSign for straightforward deals; if ACME needs redlines we can review but prefer to start from our standard DPA to reduce legal back-and-forth. Link to DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/ABCDEF-Redwood-DPA
- Security questionnaire: we can complete the vendor questionnaire. To scope effort: if the questionnaire is standard (150 Qs or fewer) we can return answers in ~3 business days; longer or customized vendor security templates (e.g., >300 Qs or requiring evidence upload for each item) may take 5–7 business days and need an SSO/dashboard screenshot set. Please confirm whether ACME requires on-site assessments or additional evidence transfer.
- Data handling: we support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM), region controls (US/EU), and provide audit logs; specific items can be included in the questionnaire response.

Attachments provided: SOC2_Summary.xlsx, SOC2-report-redwood-2026.pdf (available under NDA)

Happy to jump on a short call with your security team if helpful.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Redwood - Recap + next steps (procurement & security)

Thanks Marissa/Alice —

Commercial note: we can accept a PO with net-30 for the proposed pilot. For pilots below $25k we typically recommend the AWS Marketplace (card) path to avoid delays — we’re listed on AWS Marketplace, and card payments there are immediate. \n
If ACME wants PO terms, we’ll provide a standard order form and attach a short SOW. If you want to move faster, we can get a marketplace listing link (card payment) within 2 business days — that would let you start the pilot while procurement processes the PO.

I’ll prepare an order form and an SOW template and share later today.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@acme.com>

Thanks everyone — this is great and actionable. Quick confirmations from ACME: 
- We’ll kick procurement intake this afternoon and will route a PO once the DPA is signed and SOC2 artefacts are reviewed. Expect ~2–3 weeks for approvals.
- Please send the DocuSign DPA (preferred) and SOC2 summary to procurement@acme.com. Procurement will upload the SOC2 to our internal compliance portal (must be PDF).
- We are open to marketplace/card for the initial 30-day pilot to speed time-to-value; procurement will still require the DPA before starting payment, but the marketplace option would allow us to begin evaluation while legal finalizes the PO.

Next steps for Redwood:
- Marissa / Dev: send DocuSign DPA link and SOC2 PDF to procurement@acme.com.
- Rishi: please share the draft order form / SOW and the marketplace link (if available).

I’ll follow up if procurement needs anything else.

Best,
Alice
